items.note: The email is addressed to "Dear Ms. Alvarez."
Apartment 4B is named in the subject line and in the first sentence.
It says "I called you about it on October 3 and haven't heard back since."
It says "Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s." It doesn't write °F, but for a US landlord the meaning is clear.
It asks for the heater to be "repaired within 48 hours of this email," and the subject line says the same.
It says "Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is polite: it offers to give the technician access and asks for a confirmation. It is also firm: it gives a clear deadline and cites the lease.
Rent is never mentioned, and there are no threats.
The email is about 102 words, or about 113 with the subject line. Both are under 150.
